answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 12672 Country: Canada Title: If I am performing salaah and one of my parents calls me, should I terminate my salaah and answer them or should I continue with my salaah and answer them when I am finished? Question: If I am performing salaah and one of my parents calls me, should I terminate my salaah and answer them or should I continue with my salaah and answer them when I am finished? Answer ID: 12672 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 722/538=L/1430) If you are offering fardh salah and your parents are not calling you due to some problem, you are not allowed to cancel your salah: وبہ صرح في الإمداد بقولہ: أي لایجوز قطعھا بنداء أحد أبویہ من غیر استغاثۃ وطلب إعانۃ لأن قطعھا لا یجوز إلا لضرورۃ، وقال الطحاوي: ھذا في الفرض (شامي 2:426 ) But, if you are offering nafl salah and the parents know it, then also one may continue his salah, but if they are unaware one should cancel the salah and respond them: فإن کان في نافلۃ إن علم أحد أبویہ أنہ في الصلاۃ وناداہ لا باس أن لا یجیبہ وإن لم یعلم یجیبہ (شامي 2:426 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
